  1. Jorge Bolet — Liszt Sonata (1960), Commons — Summary names Bolet, year 1960 and upstream YouTube URL; PD-EU-audio licence template; original MP3 file history and audio metadata.. Accessed 2026-10-17.
  2. Source video linked by the Commons uploader — Upstream link supplied by Commons; no extra session or carrier metadata is inferred from it.. Accessed 2026-10-17.
  3. Liszt: Sonate in H moll — Schott, 1917 — Sibley Music Library public-domain score. Printed p. 7 identifies the Schumann dedication and 1853 composition, and shows the Lento scales followed by the Allegro’s leaping and repeated-note gestures. The catalogue identifies Liszt’s dates, 1811–⁠1886. This is a reference score, not an identification of Bolet’s performing edition.. Accessed 2026-10-18.
  4. Yale University Library — Liszt’s B-minor Sonata first edition — Exhibit of the Breitkopf & Härtel first edition: explicit 1854 publication date, Schumann dedication, transformed themes and lack of a composer-supplied written programme.. Accessed 2026-10-18.
  5. Franz Liszt — chronology — 1857 entry: first performance of the B-minor Sonata by Bülow on 22 January. The site’s existing Liszt biography separately specifies Berlin.. Accessed 2026-10-18.
  6. Liszt Sonata — thematic and formal analysis — Motif derivations, slow and fugal regions, quiet ending, 1853 composition and competing formal readings; not the source for the exact publication date or named première venue.. Accessed 2026-10-17.
